Commentary.Commentary: We are all set to begin the run chase! The Ireland players stride out to the middle, followed by Zawar Farid and Vriitya Aravind. Barry McCarthy will start with the ball.

Right then! UAE need 229 to win! They chased down over 260 in the first game and they will back themselves to chase it down. Ireland, on the other hand, need to bowl extremely well to defend this. They will need to come out hard and show some fight. An exciting run chase coming up. Join us in a while to find out.

UAE bowlers were excellent for the first 40 overs. They just kept the things tight and were not giving anything away. Zahoor Khan was the pick of the bowlers for them as he picked up a three-fer while Kashif Daud started well but was expensive in his final few overs. The spinners were economical and were not giving any freebies to the Irish but they will be very disappointed with the last few overs. They had a chance of restricting Ireland to under 200 but some poor bowling did not let that happen.

The innings did not start off well at all for the Irish. They lost their three wickets for just 10 and were in all sorts of trouble. First, Harry Tector and Lorcan Tucker tried to build a partnership but then they threw away their wickets at crucial times which put Ireland further into trouble. But, Curtis Campher and Simi Singh had other plans as they stitched a fine 91-run stand before Campher fell for 56. Simi Singh though continued and scored a fifty and a nice, little contribution from Gareth Delany helped the Irish reach 228 which looked highly unlikely at one stage.

Excellent comeback from Ireland! At one stage, they were 10 for 3 and were in complete tatters but knocks from Curtis Campher and Simi Singh has helped the Irish post a very respectable score on this wicket. UAE did well but they will be a tad disappointed with how they bowled at the death and they might feel that they let Ireland off the hook.

The umpires make their way out to the middle. They are followed by the hosts, spreading out to the field. Paul Stirling and Kevin O'Brien are the openers for Ireland. O'Brien is playing his 150th ODI for Ireland. Zahoor Khan to start off proceedings. Stirling to face. Here we go...

PITCH REPORT - There is some dampness on the wicket, owing to the dew factor in the last two days and the deck being covered. There are some dark areas on the track, which should help the spinners and seamers. However, once the sun beats down, you can expect some runs.

Ireland (Playing XI) - Paul Stirling, Kevin O' Brien, Andy Balbirnie (C), Harry Tector, Lorcan Tucker (WK), Curtis Campher, Gareth Delany, Simi Singh (IN FOR MARK ADAIR), Andy McBrine, Barry McCarthy and Craig Young.

United Arab Emirates (Playing XI) - Zawar Farid, Vriitya Aravind (WK), Chundangapoyil Rizwan, Basil Hameed (IN FOR ALISHAN SHARAFU), Muhammad Usman, Rohan Mustafa, Waheed Ahmed, Ahmed Raza (C), Kashif Daud, Karthik Meiyappan and Zahoor Khan.
TOSS TIME - It has gone in UAE's favour. UAE ELECT TO CHASE AGAIN.

We are getting a game, we are getting a game, we are getting a game! After waiting and waiting and waiting, for what - 10 days, we are ready with the second ODI. This series was supposed to have games on 8th, 10th, 12th and 14th. But Covid cases on the 8th meant that the game on the 10th got postponed to 16th. Then the game on the 12th got postponed as well. And eventually, we did not have games either on 14th or 16th. After requests from the Irish team, the UAE goverment has agreed to host this game today, as the Men In Green are desperate for a competitive game before the Afghanistan series starts on the 21st.
